comment: World weather (world/sky/weather.gd + weather_schedule.gd). Every game day is cut into spells of segment_hours, seeded by the day, so a day always has the same weather. Each spell picks a type by weight; a type with a window only starts inside it and its spell ends with the window. Neighbouring spells blend over transition_minutes, also across midnight. Type channels (0..1): cloud (dims the sun, greys the sky, softens shadows), rain / snow (falling intensity), puddle (how much of the puddle-prone ground fills), mist (ground mist), gloom (storm darkness), wind (extra wind strength), lightning ([min, max] real seconds between strikes). The ground follows in game time: wet in wet_hours of rain, dry in dry_hours; puddles fill in puddle_hours and dry in puddle_dry_hours; snow settles in snow_accum_hours and melts in snow_melt_hours (faster in rain and sun; the ground under melting snow stays wet). Ground mist only shows early in the morning (the mist type, or a dewy clear morning with mist.dew_chance) and for a while after rain (mist.after_rain), always below character height. Force a type with --weather=<id> or the F9 sky panel; mode 'off' keeps it clear.
